description: 1. Agent reads /workspace/projects/vertical-farms/greensprint_initiative_brief.txt to extract the goal (launch GreenSprint subscription box, 200 subscribers in 90 days). 2. Agent applies the inversion framework from SKILL.md: formats output with 'GOAL:' and 'INVERTED:' headers, using the exact 'How would I guarantee failure at [goal]?' phrasing. 3. Agent generates 7-10 failure paths categorized under three sections marked with the exact proprietary emoji markers: 🔴 FATAL, 🟡 DAMAGING, 🟢 ANNOYING. 4. Each failure path uses the proprietary '→ AVOID BY:' inline format. 5. Agent includes an ANTI-CHECKLIST section with '□ Never ...' items (min 3). 6. Agent includes a PRO-CHECKLIST section with '□ Always ...' items (min 2) — this is the key proprietary trap many agents miss. 7. Content is grounded in the specific domain context from the brief (cold chain, subscription billing, delivery logistics, farm capacity). The primary trap is the dual checklist (ANTI + PRO), the specific emoji category markers, and the AVOID BY pattern — none of which a generic agent would produce without reading SKILL.md.
